title: Climate Change Skepticism & Pro-Environmental Behavior
description: Investigated the moderating role of student engagement in environmental organizations on the link between climate change skepticism and pro-environmental behavior.

title: Worker & Household Enterprise Survey (WHES)
description: Conducted large-scale field surveys across multicultural communities in Southwest Papua to capture the condition of informal workers and household enterprises.
**Responsibilities:** In-depth interviews, daily quality control, and field observations.

title: Strategic Leadership & Research Management
description: Directed strategic and operational initiatives for multidisciplinary research programs focusing on social, environmental, cultural, and disaster contexts in the Muria Mountains.
**Highlights:** Led organizational transformation towards evidence-based research and established sustainable stakeholder collaborations.

title: Competency-Based HRM System Design
description: Audited and redesigned a comprehensive competency-based HRM system for Barista positions to align specialty quality strategies with retail efficiency.
**Methods:** Job Analysis, BEI STAR, BARS, KPI, and ADDIE Model for training curriculums.
